title: Varaha
hook: Hiranyaksha blocks the way up, and two weeks look back
tomorrow: his brother wants revenge. what boon does he ask for?

segments.voice: Yesterday, Varaha, and an earth who is someone: Bhudevi, lifted like someone dear, beside a psalm's the earth is the LORD's. The one who sank the earth isn't done.

Every rescue story has a moment when the hero is almost home and someone steps into the doorway. Varaha is rising through the waters with the earth on his tusk, and there in the deep is Hiranyaksha, a demon who has been roaming the waters looking for someone strong enough to fight him. He mocks the boar. He has found his match.
screen: `ALMOST HOME.` → `HIRANYAKSHA IN THE DEEP.` → `A MATCH, AT LAST.`

segments.voice: In the Bhagavata Purana, Varaha doesn't drop the earth to answer him. He sets her safely on the water first, and only then turns to fight. Varaha defeats him, and Hiranyaksha has a brother, which is where the row goes next. So the third descent ends with the earth set down safe before anything else. Now the two weeks, card by card. Lalita, rising from the fire with a sugarcane bow, and desire given back its life. Shri Mata, the first name in a portrait made of names. The Adhyatma Ramayana, with Sita kept safe in the fire and two tellings side by side. A row of avatars held together by one refrain. A fingertip fish carried from jar to sea, a boat of seeds and sages, and the Vedas brought back from the deep. Kurma holding the mountain. Poison first, and Shiva's blue throat. Treasures rising, read as holy events and as the inner churning. One sip of amrita. A boar diving all the way down, and an earth who is someone. Fish, tortoise, boar: three shapes, one who comes down.
screen: `HIRANYAKSHA BLOCKS THE WAY UP.` · `THE EARTH SET DOWN SAFE FIRST.` · `TWO WEEKS, CARD BY CARD.` · then, large: `THREE SHAPES, ONE WHO COMES DOWN.`

segments.voice: Close your eyes and let one card from these two weeks come back on its own: a fish, a tortoise, a blue throat, a sip, a boar in the deep. Stay with whichever one comes, and breathe slowly. If you pray, you can rest there with God.
Varaha: the boar who sets the earth down safe before he fights.
The line to take with you: Varaha, who sets the earth down safe first. Two weeks, three shapes.
